title: Buaflow usage-capture consent v1
description: A project's one-time answer to whether Buaflow may record usage events (EV-011). Lives at .buaflow/usage.json and is committed, so the decision belongs to the project. No file means not yet asked; a file that does not validate is read as disabled, never as enabled.

project.description: Folder name for this project in the central store.
